# Provenance: tree-construction corpus (test data, never shipped)

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/servo/html5ever
- Commit: a027c2835472d518893c906dc29c42200af3c960 (short a027c28), pinned in reference-library/_metadata/source-lock.json
- Paths: rcdom/wpt-tree-construction-tests/*.dat (web-platform-tests html5lib tree-construction data) and
  rcdom/custom-html5lib-tree-construction-tests/{custom-template,nesting-limit}.dat
- Licence: WPT data under the 3-clause BSD licence (WPT-LICENSE.md); html5ever files MIT OR Apache-2.0. Recorded as test data: never shipped, 014 tooling class.
- Copied read-only; nothing in reference-library is executed. Checksums: SHA256SUMS.
- Count note: the upstream directory holds 59 WPT `.dat` files (the task text says 63, which counted non-data entries too); total vendored `.dat` = 61. See specs/003-document-model/ERRATA.md E-003-01.
